summary.text: Demond Meeks is the incumbent Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 137 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Rochester native and former union organizer with 1199SEIU, he is serving his third full term representing the 137th Assembly District.

paragraphs.text: Meeks was born and raised in Rochester and earned an associate's degree from Monroe Community College and a bachelor's degree from SUNY Brockport.
He received labor-related training and certifications from Cornell University and worked as an Administrative Organizer with 1199SEIU, representing healthcare sector employees.
Meeks represents the 137th Assembly District and chairs the Office of State-Federal Relations.
He is a member of the Children and Families, Cities, Correction, Health, Housing, and Insurance committees.
His official biography credits him with championing the Fair Access to Victim Compensation Act and playing a role in passing the Clean Slate Act.
It also says he lives in Rochester's 19th Ward with his wife, Cratrina.
